units.text:
# Disposable qualification unit; not a production installation template.
[Unit]
Description=File mover lifecycle qualification
StartLimitIntervalSec=10
StartLimitBurst=2

[Service]
Type=simple
User=mover
Group=mover
RootDirectory=/sles
EnvironmentFile=/run/fm-sd-1.service.env
ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -eu -c 'true'
ExecStart=/tmp/debug /tmp/local/runtime-debug-copy_chunk-production-sd-1/config.json
ExecStop=/tmp/debug --stop /tmp/local/runtime-debug-copy_chunk-production-sd-1/config.json
KillMode=control-group
SendSIGKILL=no
TimeoutStopSec=75
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1
CapabilityBoundingSet=
NoNewPrivileges=yes
UMask=0077
PrivateTmp=no

# Disposable qualification unit; not a production installation template.
[Unit]
Description=File mover lifecycle qualification
StartLimitIntervalSec=10
StartLimitBurst=2

[Service]
Type=simple
User=mover
Group=mover
RootDirectory=/sles
EnvironmentFile=/run/fm-sd-1.service.env
ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -eu -c 'true'
ExecStart=/tmp/qualification-debug /tmp/local/runtime-debug-copy_chunk-shutdown-2-sd-1/config.json
ExecStop=/tmp/qualification-debug --stop /tmp/local/runtime-debug-copy_chunk-shutdown-2-sd-1/config.json
KillMode=control-group
SendSIGKILL=no
TimeoutStopSec=8
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1
CapabilityBoundingSet=
NoNewPrivileges=yes
UMask=0077
PrivateTmp=no
